course_info.trial_description: Hi all, a very warm welcome to you. First of all I congratulate you for choosing to learn Tamil with me. Tamil is one of the oldest living language in the world. pro_course_detail.title: Mastering the mother of all languages - Tamil
pro_course_detail.description: Hello all, to begin with we are going to take baby steps in Tamil. As how a new born child takes slowly its time to build up letter pronunciation and later to a complete word then into a group of words to form sentence, here we are going to do the same albeit we are rather grown up kids.  Firstly we will focus on the alphabets that are present, until you get your right pronunciation, I am not going to leave you :D (on a lighter note) Here I am obliged to give you the right lessons, so you are the master here and you should extract as much work from me as possible.  Its going to be a win-win situation for both the teacher and the student, where the teacher pushes the student to go extra mile in their efforts which in turn motivates the teacher to further up his efforts. Use me, trouble me until you get your basic rights, I believe in learning a new language, it is the learner who should ask more questions and doubts, only then you can master the art. As the saying "Rome was not built in a day", a language which is alien to you cannot be learnt overnight. Its a gradual process. You need to be very honest and stay true to your efforts.  If they are done in a right manner, you will see the results coming up. You can assess your performance from where you were before the start and where you are now.  That is how learning is done.  This is what change is.  Enjoy the process, feel it, love it, involve and immerse yourself in this beautiful journey.  By putting yourself in a situation in learning a new language itself shows how stand out you are from others.  And before ending up, I have to quote this favourite dialogue of mine from the movie "Batman Begins". "Why do we fall? So that we learn to pick ourselves up!" Make mistakes, fail, try again, fail better and learn what not do. Never lose your heart, when the going gets tough, the tough gets going. Looking forward to meet you in this journey.
